headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nick Gonzales leading the Pirates' batting effort. The Cincinnati Reds took down the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2, with Chase Burns earning the win. The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins 14-4, behind a strong team effort. The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, coming from behind in the final game. The New York Yankees' Carlos Rodón has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, including Carlos Rodón (New York Yankees) and Jason Adam (San Diego Padres), who have been placed on the 15-day injured list. Mitchell Parker (Washington Nationals) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list, while Matt Chapman (San Francisco Giants) has been placed on the 10-day injured list. Kris Bubic (Kansas City Royals) and Connor Seabold (Kansas City Royals) have been placed on the 60-day and 15-day injured lists, respectively. Corey Seager (Texas Rangers) has been placed on the 10-day injured list, and Will Vest (Detroit Tigers) has been placed on the 15-day injured list.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen. The Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' batting effort with a 3-hit, 1-home run game, including a key 4th homer on a fly ball to left center field.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Chase Burns earning the win. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 14-4 behind a strong team effort. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, coming from behind in the final game. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees' Rodón Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Yankees left-hander Carlos Rodón has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to June 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
